verdict.rationale: Brex exposes a broad first-party REST API (transactions, payments, budgets, team, expenses, accounting). It authenticates with dashboard-generated scoped tokens passed in headers and offers registrable webhooks, so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts or pipelines. Postman collections, a hosted MCP endpoint and automation integrations (Pipedream, Workato, Zapier) further show headless operation. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance, documented machine/service-account credentials distinct from user tokens, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
